rights_quarantine.note: Quarantined paths are never admitted by AF-01 manifests. Fonts under OFL, Lucide icons under ISC, SCOWL lists, Adobe CMaps under BSD-3-Clause, SAM3 port notes, and all brand marks require separate rights records before any byte redistribution.

P10-video-frame-capture.dependency_closure: Browser DOM plus canvas 2D only. No npm runtime dependency. Timeouts METADATA_TIMEOUT_MS 5000, SEEK_TIMEOUT_MS 3000, PAINT_WAIT_MS 300. AbortSignal cancellation, CORS SecurityError mapped to cors kind, blob URL ownership by caller, original playhead restored. Skelet must add frame count/time/byte caps, deterministic timestamp labels, source video hash, and rights classification around this narrow module.
P10-video-frame-capture.strongest_implementation: extract-frames.ts captureFrameAt plus extractFrames burst with ensureVideoReady, seekTo with epsilon skip, bounded paint wait, drawFrame with taint handling, and finally-restore playhead. Strongest because it is dependency-free, cancellable, CORS-aware, and restores player state.

P12-reference-board-core.dependency_closure: React plus Konva canvas plus local stores. Must map @storyteller/* aliases to Skelet, replace MoodboardPersistenceAdapter cloud sync with Skelet Collection-backed layout projection, keep localStorage only as offline draft, enforce client-only Next.js dynamic import, keyboard focus, reduced motion, mobile viewport. Tauri, hosted media, brand tokens, and private datasets excluded.
P12-reference-board-core.strongest_implementation: Board model plus BoardLibraryStore plus documents.ts plus moodboardSync.ts plus grid layout plus Konva canvas plus PresentationView plus history/snap/selection/grouping. Strongest because the typed board model, virtualized grid, canvas interactions, presentation view, and sync/conflict handling are the only mature board system among the donors.

P14-pagedraw-primitives.dependency_closure: Local canvas layer/mask/2D edit primitives only. Hosted generation calls and provider model lists excluded and replaced by Skelet capability adapter at import time.
P14-pagedraw-primitives.strongest_implementation: PageDraw local layers, masks, history stack, and paint surface. Conditional because Skelet must first prove VectorCraft/PhotoCraft adapters insufficient for the same edit.

P14-vectorcraft-headless.dependency_closure: Rust 1.95, edition 2024, workspace MIT OR Apache-2.0. CLI depends on vectorcraft-color/doc/engine/format/geom/svg/mcp/render/text plus serde_json and log. MCP crate adds image plus dev proptest/socket2. Workspace forbids unsafe_code and unwrap/expect/panic/todo in shipped code. External crates are permissive (kurbo, peniko, vello_cpu, usvg, skrifa, harfrust, egui/eframe for GUI only, wasmi/wat for plugins). Skelet must run the CLI as an explicitly installed, pinned, sandboxed per-job process with allowlisted ops and confined read/write roots. Never vendor the whole editor into Next.js.
reject: craft-fonts embedded builds without separate OFL record
P14-vectorcraft-headless.strongest_implementation: vectorcraft-cli headless batch plus vectorcraft-mcp JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio. Strongest vector path because it is the only donor with a purpose-built CLI/MCP batch surface, deny-unsafe lints, and SVG/format/render crates.

P14-photocraft-headless.dependency_closure: Headless convert/inspect/batch plus rmcp 3.5 MCP server over engine/io/format/codecs with tokio multi-thread, serde/schemars, base64, cap-std sandbox capability, getrandom. HEIF via optional photocraft-heif feature only. Windows winresource is build-only. Skelet must sandbox per job with explicit roots, CPU/memory/time limits, idempotent output registration, and no ambient network.
reject: HEIF default enablement without rights review
P14-photocraft-headless.strongest_implementation: photocraft-cli convert plus photocraft-automation MCP bridge. Strongest raster path because it exposes deterministic convert plus automation without requiring the full Photoshop-class GUI.

filmcraft_include: selected ingest/frames/timeline helpers only if P10 shows a quantified gap
lightcraft_include: selected image metadata helpers only if Skelet image pipeline lacks the capability
post-launch-evaluate.note: No launch-blocking runtime. designcraft document layout and effectcraft Lottie export are optional handoffs behind tested provider interfaces. filmcraft timeline and lightcraft RAW/segment/AI paths are deferred. lightcraft crates/segment is Apache-2.0-only and SAM3 weights plus RawNIND checkpoints are never distributed with the donor and require separate user-accepted terms.

rejected-from-core.reason: Large 3D, full video editor, hosted model marketplace, and credit systems are not launch-critical and would invert Skelet architecture.

performance_baseline.note: AF-01 sets caps, not claims. Later grains must measure on constrained local hardware and roll back on regression.

cve_and_dependency_notes.artcraft_moodboard: package.json declares no runtime dependencies; transitive React/Konva versions must be resolved from the app shell at transplant time and scanned then. No new npm dependency is added by AF-01.
cve_and_dependency_notes.artcraft_services_frame: No npm runtime dependency; browser DOM plus canvas 2D only. No new dependency added by AF-01.
cve_and_dependency_notes.rust_workspaces: All six Rust workspaces declare MIT OR Apache-2.0 workspace license (lightcraft crates/segment Apache-only). Pinned external crates observed include kurbo 0.13, peniko 0.6, vello_cpu 0.2, usvg 0.48, skrifa 0.47, harfrust 0.13, image 0.25, tokio 1, serde 1, serde_json 1, rmcp 3.5, wasmi 2.0.0, egui/eframe 0.36 (GUI only, excluded from server path). No Rust code is vendored by AF-01; full cargo audit with pinned lockfiles is required at AF-10/AF-11 before any binary is accepted.
cve_and_dependency_notes.no_paid_services: No OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, hosted embedding, vector SaaS, crawler SaaS, GPU host, or metered donor endpoint is required by any AF-01 manifest.
